anomalies.description: A car is shown in motion blur, indicating a high-speed loss of control or skid on a wet road; the vehicle appears to be veering off the road or rotating rapidly.; The car is no longer visible on the road; instead, a person (female) is seen lying on the road surface, suggesting ejection or being thrown from the vehicle during the crash.
A woman is shown restrained and lying on the ground in distress, with visible signs of struggle and pain; she is subsequently struck by a vehicle.
A black Aston Martin collides with a person lying on the road, launching the vehicle into a violent airborne roll and multiple flips down the road.

A dark sedan collides with a person lying on the road, launching the vehicle into a violent multi-rotation flip and roll across the road and into the grassy shoulder, eventually coming to rest upside-down.

A black car is airborne, flipping and tumbling across a rural road and grassy shoulder, making multiple impacts and shedding parts (e.g., wheel at f3, f13), finally coming to rest upside-down on the grass with smoke/steam emitting.

A black car is shown rolling and skidding on its roof across a grassy field after a crash, with visible debris and smoke/dust; the vehicle transitions from fully inverted to partially upright while sliding.; A dark sedan is shown skidding sideways off a wet road onto grassy terrain, kicking up dust and debris; the vehicle is clearly out of control and in the process of crashing.; The car comes to rest on its side or near-upright position, emitting smoke; close-up frames show damage and possible occupant presence inside the wreckage.

The car has come to rest on its side or roof in the grass, heavily damaged; smoke/dust lingers, and the driver’s side window is shattered with visible occupant inside—indicating the aftermath of the crash.; A severely damaged vehicle is shown in a dark, underwater or submerged environment; the structure is deformed and broken, consistent with a high-impact crash. The sequence shows progressive reveal of the wreckage and an injured occupant inside.

A man with visible facial injuries (blood, contusions) is seen slumped inside the wrecked vehicle, appearing unconscious or incapacitated. While no active attacker is visible, his helpless state combined with the context of a recent crash suggests he may have been subjected to prior abuse (e.g., assault before or during the crash). However, visual evidence of direct abuse (e.g., another person striking him) is absent; confidence is moderate due to circumstantial inference from injury and helplessness.
